channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Nikhil Gupta Pleads Guilty in Foiled $100,000 Assassination Plot, Faces 40 Years in US Prison
item.description: Gupta admitted to three federal charges in a New York court over a disrupted plot targeting Sikh separatist leader Gurpatwant Singh Pannun.

item.title: UGC Protest at Delhi University Turns Violent; Woman Journalist Alleges Assault, Police Probe Underway
item.description: A protest over the UGC’s Equity Regulations at Delhi University escalated into a clash between rival student groups, during which a woman journalist alleged assault, prompting a police investigation and renewed debate on campus safety.

item.title: 65,000 Trees, 40 Urban Forests: How Krishnakumar S Is Rewriting the Climate Story of Two Indian Cities
item.description: A Chennai environmentalist’s citizen-led initiative has transformed barren urban plots into dense native forests, offering climate relief, biodiversity revival and a scalable model for sustainable city living.

item.title: CBSE Ends Class 12 Marks Verification from 2026 as 18.5+ Lakh Students Shift to Fully Digital Evaluation
item.description: From 2026, CBSE will evaluate over 1 crore Class 12 answer sheets digitally, eliminating post-result verification to reduce errors and speed up results.

item.title: CBSE 2026 Board Exams Mandate Section-Wise Answers, Introduce Dual Class 10 Attempts Nationwide
item.description: CBSE announces major 2026 reforms including strict section-wise answer rules, dual Class 10 exams, and digital evaluation for Class 12.

item.title: PM Modi Approves Upto ₹1.5 Lakh Cashless Medical Treatment for Road Accident Victims Nationwide
item.description: Under the PM RAHAT scheme, road accident victims across India will receive cashless emergency hospital treatment up to ₹1.5 lakh, aiming to reduce preventable deaths during the critical golden hour.

item.title: Indore MBA Student, 24, Found Dead After Alleged Video Leak; Boyfriend Absconding, Probe On
item.description: A 24-year-old MBA student was found strangled in her classmate’s rented room days after an objectionable video allegedly surfaced, with police launching a manhunt for the missing suspect.

item.title: Mumbai Metro Pillar Collapse in Mulund Kills One, Government Orders Inquiry and Announces Compensation
item.description: A newly installed 6x4 ft parapet slab from Mumbai’s under-construction Metro Line-4 collapsed onto traffic in Mulund, prompting a probe and compensation announcement after one death and three injuries.

item.title: 22-Year-Old Indian Student Missing in California; Consulate Closely Tracking Case
item.description: A postgraduate student at UC Berkeley has been missing since February 10, with local police, Indian authorities and volunteers continuing coordinated search efforts in California.

item.title: People of Purpose: Sanjeeva Kumar Jha’s Story of Grassroots Roots and Corporate Responsibility at JK Lakshmi Cement Ltd
item.description: Sanjeeva Kumar Jha's evolution from Bihar's civil services aspirant to JK Lakshmi Cement's CSR head, transforming 3.5 lakh lives through education, skilling, health, and 50% renewable-powered sustainability.
